newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybean rally pushes soy products higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybean rally pushes soy products higher.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures were higher early Tuesday, mostly in response to an early rally in soybean futures, traders said.
CBOT soybeans rallied early on a private forecast for small old and new crop ending stocks from the Sparks Companies, traders said.
Sparks was said to peg 1996/97 (Aug/Sept) ending stocks at at a small 115 million bushels and new crop ending stocks were 123 million bushels.
At 1010 CDT, July soymeal was $0.40 higher at $276.80 per ton, and other months were up $0.80 to $1.90.
July soyoil was 0.14 cent a lb higher at 23.27 cents, and other months were 0.07 to 0.20 higher.
